messages:
nina (People Ops): Heads-up: we're changing the review deadline cadence to be timezone-aware for the next cycle to reduce last-minute rushes in APAC/EU. New proposal below  please RT if you own manager sign-offs.

carlos (HRBP): Appreciate this. What's the actual change vs current single UTC deadline?

nina (People Ops): Instead of 1 global cutoff, we'll have three soft windows: Americas cutoff = Mon 11:59pm PT, EMEA cutoff = Tue 11:59pm BST, APAC cutoff = Wed 11:59pm SGT. All windows map into the same calibration week but give local managers a full working-day buffer.

yuki (EM - EU): Will calibration chairs still get one consolidated packet? worried about stagger creating multiple rounds.

nina (People Ops): We will generate provisional packets after each regional window, then one consolidated packet on Thu AM PT. Chairs get visibility into regionally-flagged rows so they can pre-read. Final numbers freeze at consolidation.

priya (EM - APAC): That helps. Two questions: (1) what about cross-region managers with reports in multiple regions, and (2) does this change the import schedule?

nina (People Ops): Good Qs. (1) Cross-region managers should follow the latest cutoff among their reports (we'll auto-detect by report location and notify the manager row-by-row). (2) Import schedule: we'll run regional imports 2 hours after each regional cutoff, and consolidated import 3 hours after the final cutoff to allow last-minute fixes.

oliver (Recruiting Ops): Please note: recruiting needs any comp-impacting changes locked 48h before offers go live. If consolidated packet pushes into recruiting blackout, flag rows that are offer-critical and we'll triage.

carlos (HRBP): Escalation flow if a manager misses their region's window?

nina (People Ops): Flow: 1) Auto-reminder 6h before regional cutoff; 2) Auto-snooze bump 12h post-cutoff for documented LOA/cases; 3) If no approval after 24h, escalate to manager's manager and CC HRBP. We keep a short audit log of escalations.

yuki (EM - EU): Can we nominate alternate approvers for regional holidays? we had a bank holiday right in the middle of last cycle.

nina (People Ops): Yes  managers should nominate an alternate approver in the tracker before their region's cutoff (column: alt-approver). If not set, People Ops will attempt to select a logical backfill (manager's manager or team lead) and notify all parties.

priya (EM - APAC): For timezone-aware deadlining, will the review forms show a per-row deadline so engineers aren't confused?

nina (People Ops): Yes, the public tracker will now include a derived "row_deadline_local" column with timezone label. We'll also send a brief email to each report and manager with row-level deadlines.

scheduler-bot: Reminder scheduled: Americas cutoff alarm set for 2026-06-01T23:59-07:00 (auto)

oliver (Recruiting Ops): Also request: add a boolean column 'offer_impact' managers can flag. Recruiting will filter for true and we can triage those first during consolidation.

nina (People Ops): Will add 'offer_impact' to the tracker schema and include it in the import validation. Quick validation snippet (for transparency):
```
# export region rows, validate deadlines and offer flag
curl -s "https://internal.redwood/api/reviews/export?cycle=Q3-2026&region=APAC" -H "Authorization: Bearer $PO_KEY" -o apac.csv
python tools/validate_tracker.py --file apac.csv --check row_deadline_local,alt-approver,offer_impact
```

carlos (HRBP): One more: will calibration chairs get a highlighted view of rows that were late due to timezone vs those late due to missing manager action? we want to avoid bias.

nina (People Ops): Yes  in the packet we'll tag each late row with reason codes: 'timezone-window' (submitted before region cutoff but processed after consolidation), 'manager-delay', 'evidence-required', or 'LOA-exception'. Chairs asked to consider reason codes when adjusting.

yuki (EM - EU): Sounds reasonable. Please run a pilot for next minor cycle and share metrics (late rates by region, manager response times) so we can evaluate impact.

nina (People Ops): Agreed. Pilot plan: run this for Q3 minor cycle only, collect metrics, and present findings two weeks post-calibration. I'll post a short FAQ doc and update the tracker template. If you manage reports across regions, please verify you see per-row deadlines in the tracker; ping me in thread if not.

priya (EM - APAC): Thanks  this should reduce chaos in APAC evenings. I'll nominate alt-approvers for my teams.

oliver (Recruiting Ops): Thanks everyone. Recruiting will monitor 'offer_impact' and coordinate with People Ops if we need to freeze offer sign-offs.

scheduler-bot: Consolidated packet generation scheduled: 2026-06-04T11:00-07:00 (auto)

nina (People Ops): Final operational note: forms will still lock after final consolidation. Any exceptions after that require exec sign-off. We'll post the pilot metrics and a short 'how it looked' summary in this channel after calibration. :sparkles:
